round_verdicts.basis: The census arithmetic reproduces: 246 rows, 160 SAFE / 86 NOT-SAFE, and 132 canonical unique SAFE paths with no normalized verdict/receipt conflicts. All 109 paths added by b2f2efa are in the census and have introducing commits ancestral to origin/master. However, logs_tier.txt is a confirmed false-SAFE: the row itself records orig_verdict=NOT-SAFE and absent-from-worktree-and-HEAD, while the corrected row is SAFE/pushed; its deletion commit a1b44b1 predates the census commit. This was a dry-run; no prune followed from this row. The report's 109+21+2 grouping also differs from TSV receipt categories 111 pushed + 21 none, without changing the total of 132.

Installed souji-verify.sh matches impl-12. An isolated /tmp fixture with a hidden .ufo/waves/note.md reference was independently returned SAFE(stale), refs=0. A direct live-repo probe also returned SAFE(pushed) for the installed verifier while refs/remotes/origin is empty and the selected ref is local refs/heads/master. The R2 binding spec explicitly permits that local-master fallback, so this is a receipt-policy/spec safety gap rather than an implementation/spec conformance mismatch.

The operator list is 96/96 unique, present, and each path's introducing commit is ancestral to origin/master; the four shards contain 111 rows (96 SAFE, 15 NOT-SAFE). Seventy-five rows spell ancestor=yes; the other 21 use the alternate phrase 'intro ancestor of origin/master', and all 96 passed independent ancestry checks. Current lists show lore=1 and gd2d=4; wt-r98/99/100 each still have one unpushed commit. Their registrations are currently marked prunable because their gitdir locations are absent, so preserve-and-verify before any future prune. No prune was run.
